subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should Discord retain channel-level bounded recovery in addition to the shared reply-session self-heal proposed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920?
rationale: Both viable changes address the same conflict family at different ownership layers; repository evidence cannot determine whether maintainers intentionally want defense-in-depth or one canonical recovery owner.

options.title: Shared fix plus Discord fallback
options.body: Land the shared self-heal and retain a corrected prepared-dispatch Discord fallback for residual transient conflicts and replay-safe redelivery.

options.title: Shared fix only
options.body: Pause this PR and rely on the shared session-layer recovery if it demonstrably prevents the Discord observable failure.

recommendation.title: Shared fix plus Discord fallback
recommendation.body: Land the shared self-heal and retain a corrected prepared-dispatch Discord fallback for residual transient conflicts and replay-safe redelivery.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work established the shared reply-session initialization boundary where the canonical root recovery belongs.
